title: Offline Kanban App
prompt: Build a polished offline kanban app with columns, draggable cards, create/edit/delete flows, local persistence, search/filter, keyboard-friendly controls, responsive layout, and import/export of board data. The result must run locally without paid services.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create, edit, delete, move, search, and filter cards.
Board state persists across page reloads without a backend service.
Import and export flows preserve board data and handle invalid input gracefully.
The layout is usable on phone, tablet, and desktop widths.
The UI is polished enough for a user to judge from a screenshot or live preview.
Project includes run instructions and at least one automated or scripted sanity check.
requiredArtifacts: preview URL or local run command
